description:
Supersedes SourceDefinition, which it matches field for field apart
 from `render`. A `sources` entry loads as a FileDefinition with
 render=true.

path.description: Resolved relative to the enclosing kind.json.

schema.description:
Local path (relative to kind.json) or HTTP(S) URL to this file's
 JSON Schema. Omit for no declared shape. Declaring one makes the
 file's content a contract the runner enforces at render time: reads
 and writes go through the parsed value, not the raw string.

title:
FileDefinition is one kind.json `files` entry: a path, an optional
 `schema` describing the file's shape, and whether the file seeds the
 rendered resource.
